label: Gang-Controlled Capital
source: UN BINUH / OHCHR Mar 2026 (90%); PM Fils-Aimé May 1, 2026 (75%)
contestNote: PM Fils-Aimé claimed 75% on May 1, 2026 (CNN/Amanpour) — the first government claim of territorial rollback since 2021. UN BINUH independent estimate remains ~90% as of March 2026. Discrepancy may reflect different methodologies or political framing of early GSF joint-operation gains.
deltaNote: Up from ~60% in 2021; 26 gangs active in capital area. PM claims early GSF joint operations have pushed gangs back to ~75% as of May 2026 — UN verification pending.

label: Internally Displaced Persons
source: IOM / UN News, Jun 5–6, 2026; IOM ETT 95 (May 29 – Jun 1); OCHA Crisis in Numbers May 7, 2026
deltaNote: IOM confirmed record 1.5 million displaced as of June 5–6, 2026 — over half women and girls (UN News / IOM Chief of Mission Gregoire Goodstein). Port-au-Prince metro area crossed 300,000 IDPs for first time. 18,000+ newly displaced in May from Cité Soleil gang violence alone; 5,000+ displaced in Sud-Est (previously a refuge), demonstrating geographic spread. Since Jan 2026, 110,000+ Haitians forcibly returned from abroad. Hurricane season onset (June 2026) poses additional catastrophic risk to temporary shelters. IOM ETT-95 (May 29 – Jun 1) confirmed 1,100+ displaced from Petite Rivière de Bayonnais (Artibonite). GSF advance force (~800) has zero coverage outside Port-au-Prince city center, meaning virtually all displacement sites have no international security presence.

label: Need Humanitarian Assistance
source: WFP / OCHA, Apr 2026; IPC May 2026 projects 5.91M in IPC Phase 3+
deltaNote: More than half the population; ~2M in Emergency (Phase 4); 600K in IPC Phase 5 (Catastrophe/famine). May–Aug lean season projected at worst levels.

label: Killed (Jan–Jun 4, 2026, OHCHR)
contestNote: OHCHR June 4 cumulative: 2,310+ killed, 1,100+ injured, 699 women/girls subjected to sexual violence. Security forces responsible for ~69% of Q1 casualties (69 civilians + 5 children from drone strikes); gangs directly responsible for ~27%. Annualized pace: ~5,500–6,000 for full-year 2026.
deltaNote: Q1 BINUH figure was 1,642 (Jan–Mar); OHCHR adds ~668 more deaths April 1–June 4. Full-year 2026 pace approaching record 5,600+ of 2024. 699 women/girls sexually assaulted in 5 months.

label: GSF Personnel Deployed
source: PassBlue / Haitian Times / UN Security Council, Jun 1, 2026
deltaNote: Chad 400+ (1,500 expected mid-2026) + El Salvador (~70) + Guatemala (~75) ≈ 800 advance force. Full operations formally launched June 1, 2026 — mandate milestone, not deployment milestone — at ~15% of 5,500-person authorized ceiling (UNSCR 2793). Full force expected fall–end 2026. Gen. Erdenebat Batsuuri (Mongolia) commanding since May 14. Force concentrated exclusively in Port-au-Prince city center; Cité Soleil, Artibonite, Centre, Sud-Est have zero GSF coverage. $59M disbursed of $200M+ pledged. MSS final 150 Kenyan officers departed Apr 28, 2026. MSF Cité Soleil hospital closed Day 23 (Jun 1) with no GSF coverage in the commune.
